posts.description: Situated just a few metres south of Gauri Gudi, within the historic village of Aihole, the Yoginarayana Temple Complex is a small but architecturally significant collection of Jain shrines dating to approximately the 11th–12th century CE. posts.description: Situated within Aihole village, close to the Tryambakeshwara group of temples, Gauri Gudi (also known as Gouri Gudi or Virupaksha Temple) presents such an unassuming exterior that it would be easy to walk straight past without giving it much of a second glance.
